name: Representation SCC-Width Classes Definition
statement: A finite nonempty ample $C$ has an ordinary representation map whose edge orientation has every strongly connected component of size at most $k$. An edge in direction $i$ is directed out of $v$ exactly when $i\in r(v)$.
hypotheses: Finite nonempty ample classes on the full specified ambient cube, including original constant coordinates. Empty complementary shores have the unique empty allocation. Ordinary witnesses are the integral points of the full native allocation system. Integer k >= 1, held fixed under minors. This hierarchy increases with k, U_1 = Damp, and its union is Rep.
